2. The petitioner is in judicial custody in connection with Lakhnaur P.S. Case No. 259 of 2022 for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 323, 324, 354, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and section 4 of POCSO Act and 3(i)(r)(s)/3(2)(va) of SC/St Act lodged on 01.12.2022 by the informant, Renu Devi.

3. As per prosecution case, the petitioner established physical relationship with the victim, she got pregnant and delivered a female child on 11.06.2023 at Primary Health Centre, Lakhnaur.
4.

Though, Mrs. Usha Kumari no. 1, learned APP had vehemently opposed the prayer for bail on the ground that he Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.55013 of 2023(8) dt.13-09-2024 made a false promise of marriage, assaulted sexually and after arrival of the female child has repeatedly questioned his relationship with the girl in question.
5. Considering the fact that the petitioner wanted to settle the dispute, a co-ordinate Bench on 28.08.2023 granted provisional bail listing the matter to 13.10.2023.

sentences.text: On the earlier occasion also, on instruction, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that he was ready to face the DNA test as now he is not accepting that the female child is actually his daughter.
In that background, it would be appropriate that he faces DNA test and the informant is also ready for that.

7. The learned Trial court will be taking up the matter on 19.09.2024 and on the payment of demand Draft of Rs. 10,000/- in favour the Civil Surgeon-cum-Chief Medical Officer, Madhubani, he shall be fixing a date, so that the DNA test of the petitioner vis-a-vis the female child is conducted by a team of doctors deputed by the Civil Surgeon-cum-Chief Medical Officer, Madhubani.

If the petitioner fails to deposit the amount on 19.09.2024 before the learned Trial court in favour of the Civil Surgeon-cum-Chief Medical Officer, Madhubani and/or refuses to appear before the team of Doctors, on the date Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.55013 of 2023(8) dt.13-09-2024 fixed by the Trial court, the provisional bail granted to him shall cease and the Trial court shall ensure that he is immediately arrested.

8. The Trial court shall monitor the entire exercise for conducting the test and it is reiterated that if the petitioner fails to appear before the team of Doctors, the process for cancelling his bail bond shall be immediately taken up as this provisional bail has been given only for allowing the petitioner to have his DNA test conducted vis-a-vis the female child.
9. List this case on 25.10.2024 when the Trial court shall submit a report along with the report of the Sadar Hospital, Madhubani sent by the office of the Civil Surgeon, Madhubani in a sealed cover.

(Rajiv Roy, J)
